integrity: Claim is backed by an analytic all-probability proof, exact symbolic matrix checks and 300 supplementary deterministic-seed random trials. Approximate numbers are not proof certificates.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two independent, identically distributed half-averaging contacts on a real four-vertex path; not nonstationary policies or other horizons.
The improvement in the finite-horizon norm is approximately 0.0000377512, so the main contribution is the minimal structural separation.
Publication priority has not been independently established.
title: Four vertices first separate spectral and two-step randomized gossip design
